integrity: The all-order formula is proved by conditional affine recurrences and discrete differences, with supplementary exact finite enumeration. The original contribution is the full hierarchy; first-order identities are contextual, not claimed as independent novelty.
scientific_limitations: Uniform independent-parent random recursive trees only. No independent confirmation, no nonuniform-attachment extension, no causal intervention theorem. A potentially equivalent higher-order formulation could exist in older insertion-history literature.
title: Alternating mixed-interaction hierarchy for root attachments and path length in random recursive trees
